title: Download output
description: After success, returns output bytes with HTTP 200, application/octet-stream, and an attachment filename. Requires the owner key. Before success returns 409; missing jobs return 404.

sections.title: Behavior
paragraphs: After success, returns output bytes with HTTP 200, application/octet-stream, and an attachment filename. Requires the owner key. Before success returns 409; missing jobs return 404.

sections.title: Response headers
paragraphs: The body is the converted file itself. Do not parse it as JSON. The server uses a generic attachment name; choose the application’s preferred filename when saving.

sections.title: Downloading and cleanup
paragraphs: Repeated downloads are allowed while the job is retained and the same key is valid. If a transfer fails, discard or replace its partial output before retrying. Save to a new or temporary path to protect existing files.

Download requires succeeded. A failed job also returns 409 rather than returning an error document as a file. Read the job status to distinguish waiting from conversion failure. Delete only after your application has saved the output.
